svg.text: LP-MSPM0G3507, seen from above, USB unplugged. Add the wires in the numbered order; each number sits at both ends of its wire and in the list below. The schematic shows the same circuit in symbols.
J1 and J2 are the outer columns, J3 and J4 the inner ones; pin 1, 21, 40 and 20 are at the USB end.
Wire colours: red 3.3 V, orange 5 V, black ground; every other colour is one signal.

g.text: Breadboard: holes a to e, and f to j, in one column are joined; each long rail is joined end to end.
Column 1 is at this end; rails and holes count up toward the top.
Wires, in the order you add them
Ground rail (blue, hole 2) to J3 pin 22 (GND)
Relay coil plus, breadboard j4 to J3 pin 21 (5V)
Relay coil minus, breadboard j5 to Transistor collector, breadboard j12
Transistor emitter, breadboard j10 to Ground rail
Relay driver output (pin picked at the bench)
Base resistor, breadboard j8 to Pick at the bench
Button input (pin picked at the bench)
Button leg A, breadboard j20 to Pick at the bench
Button leg B, breadboard a22 to J2 pin 20 (GND)
Relay COM, breadboard j6 to 12 V supply plus
Relay NO, breadboard j7 to Lamp plus lead
Lamp minus lead to 12 V supply minus
5 V relay: COILP in g4, COILN in g5, COM in g6, NO in g7
1N4001 diode: A in i5, K in i4
8050 transistor: E in g10, B in g11, C in g12
1 kohm resistor: one leg in h8, other leg in h11
Push button: leg 1 in f20, leg 2 in f22, leg 3 in e20, leg 4 in e22
Pick at the bench: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
Pick at the bench: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
12 V supply: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
12 V lamp: beside the breadboard, pins toward the wires
Switch only low-voltage loads with the kit relay; never mains.
Then plug in USB, run the build, and expect
The relay clicks and the lamp lights on a press, and goes out on the next.
The same circuit as a schematic

svg.text: Fox Red Labs. Pins from the build's pin table, the one the program is built from; the 3D build on the page shows the same wiring step by step. Board picture: TI SLAU873E, figure 1-1.
